title: text — notes
summary: What notes are for, that they have no ports, and how to write, format and edit one.

object 0.parms:
# text — notes
A note is a comment on the canvas, like this one. It explains a patch to whoever opens it next, and is saved with the patch. Max calls this a comment.

object 1.parms: 1. A note has no inlets or outlets. It takes part in nothing: the patch runs the same with or without it.

object 2.parms: 2. To write one, type text followed by your words into the object box (press N, or double-click empty canvas). Shift+Enter starts a new line, and Enter creates the note.

object 3.parms:
3. A line that starts with # and a space is a heading, like the one at the top.
Long text wraps. In edit mode, drag a note's right edge to make it wider or narrower.

object 4.parms: 4. Double-click a note in edit mode to change its text. A tutorial is read-only: copy it to your project to try.

object 9.parms: Notes as documentation: this toggle starts a metro, and the counter under it counts its ticks, two a second.
